subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II + Control Sample Deliverables for HealthPrime
messages:
From: Elena Torres <security@healthprime.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <auditor@brightaudit.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II + Control Sample Deliverables for HealthPrime

Hi Aditya,

As part of HealthPrime's vendor security review for an upcoming integration, our external auditor (copied) needs the following to complete a scoped SOC 2 Type II acceptance: 

- Current SOC 2 Type II report (latest opinion + control matrix)
- A bridge letter if the report period does not cover activity through Oct 31, 2026
- Scoped control samples for: MFA enforcement (authentication logs showing challenge/results), privileged account access reviews (evidence of attestation and exceptions), and retention/deletion policy evidence for auth logs

We prefer CSV slices for logs (timestamped, pseudonymized user ids okay) and PDF copies for attestation artifacts. Can you confirm:
1) Audit period covered by your report and any planned bridge letter?
2) Whether you can provide log slices covering Oct 1–31, 2026 for MFA challenges and results, and a 12-month privileged access review bundle?
3) Expected delivery timeline and point of contact for secure transfer (we can accept Drive link or SFTP).

We'd like to finalize evidence to the auditor by Nov 12 to stay on schedule. If any of this is sensitive, let us know and we can draft a minimal-scope agreement.

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Head of Vendor Security
HealthPrime

Attachments: n/a
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <security@healthprime.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <auditor@brightaudit.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + Control Sample Deliverables for HealthPrime

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list and timeline. We're happy to support HealthPrime and BrightAudit. Quick answers up front, followed by a proposed plan: 

1) SOC 2 Type II report: Our latest Type II covers the period 2025-11-01 through 2026-04-30. We can produce a standard bridge letter covering May 1 — Oct 31, 2026 if required.

2) Log slices & control samples: We can provide: 
   - MFA slice: Oct 1–31, 2026, including timestamp, event_type (challenge, success, fail), device_id (pseudonymized), and geo-iso fields.
   - Privileged access review: the most recent quarterly review report (Q3 2026) plus the reviewer attestations; if you need a 12-month bundle we can assemble quarterly snapshots back to Nov 2025.
   - Retention evidence: policy document (pdf) plus a small retention verification sample showing deletion timestamps.

3) Delivery and timeline:
   - We can deliver the initial package (SOC 2 report + draft bridge letter + small MFA CSV sample ~48 hours) by Nov 7 if you confirm acceptance criteria.
   - Full slices and privileged review bundle by Nov 10.
   - Secure transfer: we prefer a restricted Drive folder with limited access and expiration (we will share with the auditor and HealthPrime SSO emails). If SFTP is required, we can arrange.

Questions / clarifying asks from our side: 
- Does BrightAudit require raw IP addresses in the logs or is anonymized geo acceptable?
- For privileged access reviews, do you need reviewer identity plus timestamps for attestations, or just the signed PDF artifacts?
- Any specific redaction rules for PII in the MFA slices?

I have attached a draft runbook describing the format of the CSV slices and a sample bridge letter template. If we get green light on the acceptance criteria, we will proceed.

Proposed next step: 30-min sync tomorrow Nov 6 at 10:00 PT to confirm scope. Please let me know if that works or propose another slot.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: privileged_access_review_runbook.pdf (stub), draft_bridge_letter.docx (stub)
From: Samir Patel <auditor@brightaudit.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Elena Torres <security@healthprime.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + Control Sample Deliverables for HealthPrime

Thanks Aditya / Elena — quick clarifications from BrightAudit: 

- IP addresses are not required; anonymized device identifiers + geo-ISO is acceptable for our testing.
- For privileged access reviews we need: reviewer identity (name + role), date of attestation, and the underlying list of privileged accounts reviewed. A signed PDF combined with a CSV manifest is ideal.
- For MFA slices: include an event mapping key (event_type codes) and confirm whether the challenge/response values are hashed (we accept hashed identifiers).

Acceptance criteria attached (see "Sample Acceptance Criteria.pdf"). If Redwood can deliver the small MFA sample by Nov 7 and the remaining artifacts by Nov 10, that meets our testing window. We will need a signed bridge letter if the SOC 2 report period does not include Oct 2026.

Samir Patel
Principal, BrightAudit
BrightAudit LLC

Attachments: Sample Acceptance Criteria.pdf
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <security@healthprime.com>, Samir Patel <auditor@brightaudit.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 7 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II + Control Sample Deliverables for HealthPrime

Elena / Samir — confirmed and next steps below. Thanks for the quick turnaround. 

Plan (deliverables & dates):
- Nov 7 (EOD): SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) + draft bridge letter (docx) + MFA sample CSV (Oct 1–31 slice, anonymized device_id, event_type mapping) — shared to a restricted Drive folder.
- Nov 10: Privileged access review bundle: Q3 2026 signed attestation (PDF), CSV manifest of accounts reviewed (with reviewer_name + attestation_date), plus historical quarterly snapshots back to Nov 2025 (zipped PDF set).
- Nov 10: Retention evidence package (policy PDF + deletion verification sample CSV).

Delivery method: restricted Google Drive share to the three emails in this thread; folder will have 30-day expiration and download logging enabled. If HealthPrime requires SFTP, let me know and we'll open a transfer window.

Exceptions / notes: 
- We will redact full usernames and IP addresses; device_id and hashed_user_id will be provided per the acceptance criteria.
- If the auditor needs additional fields, please escalate before Nov 9 so we can include them in the full bundle.

I've attached the runbook and a small test CSV (first 50 lines) in the Drive folder now. Let me know if you'd like to walk through the sample on the sync tomorrow. 10:00 PT still works for us — confirming if that's okay for Elena.

Best regards,
Aditya Rao
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
